name: Messenger to Stormwind
summary: In Lakeshire, Magistrate Solomon sends an urgent plea for help to Stormwind. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs press around the town, and he has no garrison troops to spare for the journey. He entrusts a traveler with The State of Lakeshire for General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.

sections.title: A Cry Across the Mountains
sections.body: Gnolls contest every road from Lakeshire, while Blackrock orcs raid from the north. The town's guardsmen are stretched beyond their limits. Magistrate Solomon cannot spare fighting men for the days-long ride to the capital, so a traveler carries his official plea for regular troops to the city gates.

sections.title: Bureaucracy and the High Seat
sections.body: General Marcus Jonathan commands Stormwind's defense. Solomon's report reaches him, and he respects the magistrate's leadership and recognizes the urgency. Yet army protocol bars Jonathan from mobilizing troops without a royal directive. Redridge's defense must wait until he consults the young King Anduin and the regency council.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Solomon need a messenger?
faq.answer: Gnolls and Blackrock orcs threaten Lakeshire, and every local guardsman is needed to defend the town and hold the bridge. Magistrate Solomon entrusts travelers with his urgent appeals for aid.

faq.q: What is in 'The State of Lakeshire' report?
faq.answer: The State of Lakeshire is an official account of the crisis in the Redridge Mountains. It details rising enemy numbers, casualties, and the town's imminent fall without regular soldiers from the capital.

General Marcus Jonathan commands the Stormwind City Guard and is a high-ranking leader in the Stormwind Army. He monitors the city gates and reports directly to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the crown.

faq.q: Why doesn't General Jonathan send soldiers right away?
faq.answer: General Jonathan cannot deploy the army on his own authority. He must bring Solomon's report before the King and regency council for an official royal mandate before troops can march.

faq.q: Is the road between Lakeshire and Stormwind safe?
faq.answer: No. Aggressive gnoll bands and Defias highwaymen plague the paths through Redridge and into Elwynn, making the journey perilous for lone messengers.

faq.q: Does Stormwind end up sending help?
faq.answer: Political turmoil and delay in the capital hold back any real army response. Lakeshire and Magistrate Solomon are left to rely almost entirely on mercenaries and volunteers.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Lakeshire's plea reveals the strain between the prosperous capital and border settlements fighting for survival on the kingdom's edges.
As a human, you know Redridge is ancestral Stormwind territory. Seeing fellow humans left behind by bureaucratic red tape can sting your patriotism.
As a paladin, you carry the desperate's pleas to leaders held back by court politics, testing your duty, your protection of others, and your righteous action.
